lines.speaker: dewey
lines.text: A large orange cat occupies the exact center of the room — which is also the exact center of whatever you were about to do.

lines.speaker: dewey
lines.text: He does not move. He is not going to move. You are, apparently, the one being evaluated here.

nodes.summary: Met Dewey. He was unimpressed, magnificently.

lines.speaker: dewey
lines.text: The purr is entirely disproportionate to the cat. Somewhere below your ribs, the day’s arithmetic quietly improves.

nodes.summary: Petted Dewey. Worth the step. Worth most steps.

lines.speaker: dewey
lines.text: Dewey sees you coming and rolls over with the weary generosity of a monarch extending a hand. This is your job now. There is no pension.

nodes.summary: You are now Dewey’s staff. There is no pension.

lines.speaker: dewey
lines.text: He is asleep before you touch him, purring before you are near. The manor’s most rigorous critic has filed his review: staying.

nodes.summary: Dewey’s review of you is in: staying.

lines.speaker: dewey
lines.text: Dewey is sitting on your journal. Precisely on it. The page he warmed is one of the lexicographer’s fragments. Cats file by importance.

nodes.summary: Dewey sat on a fragment. Cats file by importance.

lines.speaker: dewey
lines.text: One slow blink as you pass. In cat, this is a standing ovation.

lines.speaker: dewey
lines.text: The night the word came back, Dewey sat on the Sanctum landing until dawn. The Portrait swears they did not speak. The cat has made no statement.

nodes.summary: Dewey kept vigil on the landing. No statement was issued.

lines.speaker: dewey
lines.text: The cat has achieved loaf. The loaf is total. Interrupting it would be a crime in several old languages.

lines.speaker: dewey
lines.text: The tail tip flicks: once, twice. Whatever Dewey is watching on the empty wall, it is apparently riveting.

lines.speaker: dewey
lines.text: Dewey is asleep in a square of sunlight. There is no window on this wall. Nobody asks anymore.

lines.speaker: dewey
lines.text: Dewey escorts you to the door — three steps ahead, tail up, entirely certain the whole house is his idea.

lines.speaker: dewey
lines.text: Dewey walks you three paces toward nothing, sits, and stares at a stretch of wall where a Gallery would hang if the house had put one there yet. He does not blink.

lines.speaker: dewey
lines.text: When you look away he is still looking. Cats do not point. This is as near as the species comes, and he plainly considers it generous.

nodes.summary: Dewey sat and stared at a wall where a Gallery ought to be.
